name: caldav
description: Manage calendars, events, and todos on a CalDAV server.
summary: Manage CalDAV calendars, events and todos

default_timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for bare (offset-less) datetimes, e.g. Europe/Athens. Defaults to UTC when unset.

freebusy_excluded_calendars.description: Comma-separated calendar names ignored by the free_busy tool (case-insensitive, trimmed). Defaults to 'Birthdays,Namedays' when unset; set to an empty string to exclude no calendars by name.
